name: RESEARCH_INSIGHT_SYMBOLS_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: RESEARCH_INSIGHT_SYMBOLS_20261107 — LQ-20261107-124, research-insight-extractor wrote three defects
into research_insights: a source row's topic code uppercased into its symbol column (67 of the last 198 rows,
5,197 of 52,520 overall), source_id NULL on every row although source_reference was populated, and the
extractor's neutral/0.5 default stored as an observation (47,388 rows, 90%). Each test pins one decision: a
value is a symbol only if it is ticker-shaped AND a known instrument; source_id is an exact URL-host match to
research_sources or NULL (never guessed from a feed name); a signal-less row is written active=false and is
reported as no_signal, not counted as produced. Hermetic: fake cursor/connection, synthetic rows only.
